front.title: The IETF is for Everyone: Toward Inclusive and Equitable Participation in Internet Governance

author.organization: University of Toamasina / ISOC Comoros Chapter

abstract.t: Participation in the IETF remains very unevenly distributed across regions, and Africa is among the least represented. This document argues that closing this gap is a shared responsibility and proposes a two-track approach. Outside the IETF, universities, technical communities, Internet governance forums, and regional institutions in underrepresented regions need to demystify the IETF and bring academics, students, and young engineers toward its work. Within the IETF, barriers to entry can be lowered further, and holding an IETF meeting in Africa would send a strong signal and act as a catalyst, meeting a local community prepared by the first track. The document proposes concrete actions, indicative metrics, and next steps for both tracks.
